name: Lichterfest am Achensee
beschreibung: The Achensee Light Festival transforms the riverside promenade into a sea of thousands of candles and lanterns. Live music, pyrotechnic shows, and a breathtaking fireworks display over the lake mark the evening’s climax. A romantic summer event for all ages.
kurzbeschreibung: Thousands of lights, fire shows, and a spectacular fireworks display along the shores of the Achensee.
